state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors state that an empirical benchmark is no substitute for formal guarantees and that it, like previous debate experiments, only compares reward for simulated aligned versus misaligned behaviour, so results assume current language models can simulate both reasonably well when instructed. They add that only current models can be tested, extrapolating ASD versus EAS trends is not a formal guarantee, and protocols that do well may only work where ground truth is available.
title: Benchmark relies on prompted LLMs simulating aligned and misaligned behaviour
